resources.string: Another app or link requested a Git action. Review the repository and action before allowing this one run.
Your commit is saved locally. Its upload was not confirmed.
More than one folder has this name. Choose the intended working copy.
Uses this repository’s saved connection, account and author settings. Changes to the reviewed branch or connection stop this request.

Returning opens the destination below and shares the action result, branch and commit identifiers. Credentials and local folder paths are never included. Choose automatic return before approving the run, or return the result yourself afterward.

Anyone with this link can run this exact action and commit message on this repository without another prompt, including future local changes. The branch, connection, account and return destinations stay fixed. Keep the link private. You can revoke it from Repository actions → Authorized links. Creating a link does not run Git.
Return results automatically to the reviewed destinations
Authorized link %1$s copied. Keep it private and paste it into your automation. Its token cannot be recovered later; create another link if needed.
Authorized links run the saved action without another prompt. Changed or revoked links stop here. Manage permissions in Repository actions → Authorized links.
The authorized link could not be copied. Review the repository again, and check Authorized links before retrying.
Anyone using this link will lose permission to run this action or return results automatically. Work already sent to Git may have finished.
Authorized links could not be read. Saved records were kept and cannot run until repaired.

Remove all saved link authorizations, including unreadable records? Every existing authorized link will stop working. Create new links from a reviewed automation request. Repositories, files, accounts and launcher shortcuts are kept.
No return URL was supplied. The result stays here.
No app could open the return destination. Your result is kept here. You can try returning again without repeating the Git action.
Result handed to Android. The receiving app controls what happens next.
There is no active request. After restarting GitSync.md, open a new callback link to review it again.
Another request arrived while this one was open. It was not queued or run. Finish or close this request before opening another.
